title: Hearing through affidavit and documentary evidence

content.general_rule: Every complaint shall be heard by the District Commission on the basis of affidavit and documentary evidence placed on record
content.exception: The District Commission may allow hearing or examination of parties in person or through video conferencing
conditions: an application is made for hearing or for examination of parties in person or through video conferencing
after recording its reasons in writing

user_queries: What is the procedure for complaint hearing?
